title: Composable help-tooltips and error-priority protocol for form inputs
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Problem: Our current approach to inline help, contextual tooltips, and validation errors has grown ad hoc. Multiple components render assistance and error UI independently which leads to inconsistent priority, duplicated ARIA announcements, and token mismatches (e.g., different semantic red/amber uses).

Goal: Define a composable protocol and visual language so that any input (text field, select, toggle, chip input) can opt into a single assistive layer. The protocol should: unify token usage for states (error, warning, success, info), define an error-priority algorithm for grouped fields and multi-step forms, specify motion and stacking rules for tooltips and helper text, and set accessibility requirements (ARIA roles, announcement strategy, keyboard interactions).

Deliverables:
- Token mapping table (semantic tokens mapped to color/contrast tokens for light/dark/compact).
- UX protocol document with rules for: stacking order, when to show inline vs tooltip, transient vs persistent helper text, and animation durations.
- Accessibility checklist: aria-live region strategy, focus transfer rules, screen reader examples.
- Component guidance for TextField, Select, Toggle, and CompositeField wrapper with code-ready props (assistiveLayerLevel, errorSeverity, persistentHelpId).
- Design artifacts: Figma file with variants + motion specs.
- Test plan: keyboard/screen-reader QA scenarios and unit/integration tests for render priority and announcement deduplication.
comments: 2025-02-18 - Aisha Patel: Created initial ticket after design grooming with PM and Eng leads. Noted recurring customer support cases where validation messages overlapped helper text on narrow mobile viewports.
2025-02-20 - Marco Ramirez: Drafted token mapping and sketch for single assistive-layer wrapper component. Added initial Figma frames for light/dark and compact density.

2025-02-24 - Priya Nair (Accessibility Review): Requested explicit aria-live guidance and examples for duplicate announcements when both field and group emit errors. Recommended using polite live for non-blocking helper updates and assertive for errors that move focus.

2025-02-28 - Engineering (ENG-1842): Confirmed runtime constraints for composable layer: must avoid extra DOM nodes per input in high-throughput lists. Proposed a single portal node attached at form root for announcements.

2025-03-02 - Marco Ramirez: Updated spec to include announcement de-duplication algorithm and introduced assistiveLayerLevel prop (0 = none, 1 = field-only, 2 = group-aware, 3 = form-global). Added sample code snippets to GitHub PR.

2025-03-04 - Product (Dana Liu): Reviewed and requested that error-priority algorithm surface validation blockers before info helpers during rollouts. Asked for a short rollout plan and toggle in Console to enable the new behavior for canary customers.
